registryAssessment: Medina Municipality’s official GeoPortal announcement lists approved land parcels, land-use and plan layers as part of its municipal geospatial information. officialSources.observation: Official 2024 announcement describes the public GeoPortal, including approved land parcels, land uses, residential plan boundaries and city urban extent.
Official portal provides geospatial and municipal information and map browsing for users; its advertised parcel layer could not be anonymously queried through the underlying REST layer.
Municipal survey-decision service card requires sign-in via national single sign-on; it is a separate administrative service and not used for geometry access.
Layer metadata identifies a land parcel layer, but anonymous REST requests returned HTTP 499 Token Required; no request was made with a token.

geometryDecision: No geometry was requested: the official layer metadata endpoint requires a token. No token, credentials, or authenticated request was used.
